Machine, workspace, and path information is redacted._"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The square launch film on the project site was rendered locally with the open-source HyperFrames fra"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"are launch film on the project site was rendered locally with the open-source HyperFrames framework."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Why dsh-alpha"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Coding agents are useful on their own, but real work quickly spreads across laptops, build hosts, GP"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"U machines, and repositories that live at different paths. dsh-alpha adds the missing control plane:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- see which machines and agents are online;
- treat the same Git repository on different machines as"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" one logical workspace;
- route a task to the right machine, runtime, model, and permission mode;
- "},{"id":"p9s3","text":"stream progress, approvals, cancellation, and results back into the same conversation;
- reconnect a"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"nd recover durable task history when a Worker temporarily disappears."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"dsh-alpha is a plugin for DSH (DeepSeek Harness). It coordinates existing provider CLIs; it does not"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" replace their installation, authentication, or security controls."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Mental model"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Workers connect outward to the master, so they do not need public IP addresses. Repository identity "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"is separated from machine-local paths, and execution remains constrained to each Worker's explicit a"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"from machine-local paths, and execution remains constrained to each Worker's explicit allowed roots."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Highlights"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| Capability | What it changes |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Global workspace inventory | One repository can be recognized across several machines and local pa"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ths. |
| Repository-aware scheduling | Prefer a Worker that already has the repository; clone on dem"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"and only inside an allowed root. |
| Per-turn Worker controls | Select Agent, model, reasoning effor"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"t, and permission mode without leaving the conversation. |
| Event-driven results | Dispatch once, w"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"ait on events, and resume with the same durable task ID after interruption. |
| Approval handoff | W"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"orker approval requests return to the active Alpha session instead of hanging invisibly. |
| Reverse"},{"id":"p16s7","text":" gateway | Workers connect to the master through authenticated WebSocket sessions and reconnect auto"},{"id":"p16s8","text":"matically. |
| Operational tooling | Web sidebar, headless runner, status CLI, Worker doctor, and mu"},{"id":"p16s9","text":"lti-device acceptance checklist. |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### Requirements"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- Node.js 22.13 or newer (task events use the built-in SQLite module)
- DSH `0.1.0-rc.8` or newer
- "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"pnpm (used by `dsh plugin`)
- the provider CLI you want to run, already installed and authenticated "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"on the machine that executes it"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### DSH Web"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Open **Alpha master** from the Web sidebar, choose a workspace or keep automatic routing enabled, th"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"en start a conversation."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"For account login, use DSH `0.2.1-rc.5` or newer and run `dsh-alpha login-setup` as the master user."},{"id":"p24s2","text":" Behind an HTTPS proxy, set `DSH_ALPHA_LOGIN_ORIGIN=https://your-domain` and restart the master. A s"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ingle administrator account supports login and logout; registration is unavailable. Keep Cloudflare "},{"id":"p24s4","text":"DNS and Tunnel mappings, and remove the target Access policy only after verifying account login. See"},{"id":"p24s5","text":" the deployment guide."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### Headless master"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The installer updates only the dsh-alpha managed block and preserves configuration outside it."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### Optional Jev routing"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Set `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` and `DSH_ALPHA_JEV_ROUTING=1` in the master process to let Jev choose the wor"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"kspace, Agent, and model for new requests without an Agent selected in the UI. A selected Agent stil"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"l dispatches directly. The task engine continues to enforce the UI scope, model capabilities, filesy"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"stem boundaries, and approvals. Keep tokens out of "},{"id":"p39s2","text":"repositories, URLs, screenshots, and process logs."},{"id":"p40s1","text":"## Supported runtimes"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"The default scans every supported runtime and advertises those with an available executable. `DSH_AL"},{"id":"p41s2","text":"PHA_WORKER_PROVIDERS` is an optional override to restrict candidates."},{"id":"p42s1","text":"| Provider ID | Runtime | Discovery |"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"| `codex` | Codex app server / CLI | Automatic |
